title.narrative: GEO/FLC Media Literacy for Teachers and Students as a tool against disinformation
GEO/FLC Media Literacy for Teachers and Students as a tool against disinformation

description.narrative: Hanke keskittyy disinformaation ja fake news levittämisen estämiseen lisäämällä opettajien ja oppilaiden medialukutaitoa. Ihmiset saavat tietoa eri kanavien kautta (analogiset/digitaaliset, some, yksityiset/julkiset mediatalot). Sodan ja jatkuvien kriisien aikana Georgia on erittäin haavoittuva disinformaatiolle jolle kansalaiset altistuvat. Disinformaation leviäminen on yksi isoimmista ongelmista Georgiassa, se keskittyy lähinnä siihen, että Georgian ja Euroopan arvot ovat keskenään epäsopivat.

This project revolves around preventing the spread of fake news and disinformation in Georgia by increasing the media literacy of civic education teachers and their students. Nowadays, people receive information through different channels, be it digital or analogue, social media or public/private broadcasting outlets. In times of war and constant crisis, countries like Georgia are quite vulnerable to disinformation which their citizens are exposed to on different media. The spread of disinformation remains one of the most pressing problems Georgia is facing. Disinformation in Georgia is largely focused on presenting Georgian and European values as incompatible with each other, as well as presenting the European Union as incompatible with the history, religion, tradition, and culture of Georgia.
